visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a macro close-up of a large, pale purple ball covered in fine white powder, suggesting a soft, doughy texture. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the granular details of the powder and the slight indentations on the surface of the object. A static camera angle maintains focus on the center of the food item, which sits on a neutral-colored background. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-close shot of a glass bowl filled with chunks of cooked taro. A hand wearing a clear plastic glove enters the frame and pours melted yellow butter over the taro, followed by white sugar powder and vibrant purple potato powder. The wooden tabletop provides a warm, domestic context. (3) A hand uses a metal masher to vigorously crush the taro and powders together. The mixture transforms from solid chunks into a thick, uniform purple paste within the glass bowl. The camera captures the texture change clearly, focusing on the movement of the masher. (4) The camera shifts to a medium shot of a male chef wearing a white uniform with his name embroidered on the chest. He stands against a white brick wall, holding a metallic ice cream scooper and smiling at the camera, providing a professional presentation. (5) Back to the close-up of the glass bowl, hands use the scooper to form a perfect ball of the purple taro paste. The lighting remains bright and professional, emphasizing the smoothness of the paste. (6) A hand holds the taro ball, using a finger to create a deep indentation in the center. A cube of white cream cheese is placed into the hole, and the taro paste is carefully folded over to seal the filling before being rolled back into a sphere. (7) The scene transitions to a shallow white dish filled with clear water. Hands dip translucent, circular rice paper sheets into the water one by one to soften them, showcasing the transparency and texture of the material. (8) A softened, transparent sheet is draped over a small white ceramic bowl. The filled taro ball is placed in the center of the sheet. The background shows a brown silicone baking mat on the counter. (9) The hands gather the edges of the rice paper, wrapping the taro ball tightly and twisting the excess at the bottom to form a smooth outer skin. The camera stays in a tight close-up to show the precision of the wrapping. (10) The finished balls are rolled in a tray of fine white powder, ensuring they are completely and evenly coated. The video ends with three completed desserts arranged on a dark blue plate with a patterned tablecloth underneath.
